core_principles: Editorial Elegance: Treat the layout like a high-end architectural magazine.
Gold as an Accent, not a Base: Use the brand gold (#C9A961) for highlights, calls to action, and subtle borders. Do not overuse it.
Crisp Typography: Pair a classic high-contrast serif for headings with a sterile, highly legible geometric sans for body copy.
Negative Space: Use generous padding (p-16 to p-32) to let elements breathe. Luxury is uncrowded.

grid_strategies: Bento Grid for 'Why MARQ' and 'Featured Investments': Use asymmetric grid spans (e.g., col-span-2 for key items, col-span-1 for secondary) to create visual tension.
Hero overlapping: The hero enquiry form should ideally overlap the bottom of the hero image or be placed in a side-by-side bento layout to break standard symmetry.

surface_styles.cards: bg-white border border-[#1A1A1A]/10 rounded-none shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1
surface_styles.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#1A1A1A]/10 sticky top-0 z-50
surface_styles.forms: Inputs should have bg-transparent, border-b border-[#1A1A1A]/20 rounded-none focus:border-[#C9A961] focus:ring-0 px-0 py-2. High-end minimal look.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Buttons and links should transition smoothly. Gold buttons hover to a deeper gold. Charcoal buttons hover to Gold.
motion_and_interaction.reveal_animations: Use Framer Motion to gently fade-up (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1) text and images as they scroll into view.
motion_and_interaction.image_zoom: On card hover, background images should scale up slightly (scale-105) over 0.5s while the container maintains overflow-hidden.

hero_image.description: Hero section background: Modern white and brown concrete luxury architecture.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text on gold or grey backgrounds meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast ratios. Darken text if necessary.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, and links MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-enquiry-submit"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the landing page as a single-page React app using Vite and Tailwind CSS. The file is .jsx.
Install Google Fonts 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' in index.html.
Use standard HTML5 structural tags and apply Tailwind CSS directly. Do not overuse Shadcn for pure layout blocks; use it for complex components like Select or Accordion if needed.
Ensure the hero section features the enquiry form prominently, potentially floating over the right side of the hero image, with a backdrop blur for readability.
For the 'Why MARQ' section, utilize a creative asymmetric grid (bento box style) where each letter (M, A, R, Q) gets a distinct visual treatment.
Make sure the gold logo is prominently displayed in the sticky header.
Apply data-testid to every CTA, form field, and interactive component.
Implement smooth scrolling (Lenis is recommended, or native CSS smooth scrolling).
